acceptance: All original Adapter checks, R7 nominal envelope/clearance and extra guard targets, plus normalized Gaussian eta >= 0.99 in independent ABCD/Quadrature
clearance_diagnostic: Among observed optically qualifying prescriptions that pass all non-enclosure package checks, record the least total outward movement of envelope faces with other inputs frozen. Recheck that prescription with the derived expanded envelope. This is a sampled design requirement, not a lower bound.
